title: Start Date for Counting the Months of a Cushion Reship (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Definition.** In the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the months of a no-charge reship of the fitting cushion item are counted from a start date to the replaced line's covered-through date. The start date is:

- **the handling day**, when the fitting item's earlier supply had already run out before the handling day;
- **the day that earlier supply runs out**, when it is still running on the handling day.

The fitting item's earlier supply runs out on the covered-through date of the fitting cushion item's latest coverage-billed line. Where the enrollment has no coverage-billed line of the fitting item, no start date is set under this definition.

## Input — judgement — output

| Fitting item's earlier supply | Start date |
|---|---|
| ran out before the handling day | the handling day |
| still running on the handling day (runs out that day or later) | the day it runs out |
| none on record | not set under this definition |

## Cases (hypothetical dates; replaced line shipped 1 March, covered through 31 May; handled 15 April)

- Earlier supply ran out 10 April: start date 15 April.
- Earlier supply runs out 15 April: still running on the handling day, so the start date is 15 April.
- Earlier supply runs out 20 April: start date 20 April.
- No earlier coverage-billed line of the fitting item: no start date under this definition.
